P1.2.text: Integra LifeSciences has a broad portfolio of innovative products and solutions used in neurosurgery, wound reconstruction and care, surgical reconstruction, surgical instrumentation and lighting, and ear, nose and throat.

P1.3.text: As supervisor of manufacturing operations at Integra LifeSciences' Le Locle facility, Lucie Fillolleau helps lead the production of Integra LifeSciences valves used in the management of hydrocephalus.

P1.4.text: Integra LifeSciences Announces 100th Patient Enrolled in AERA® Pediatric Registry

P1.5.text: From Severe Burns to a Life in Motion

P1.6.text: At just eight years old, Tyler Schultz suffered severe burns from a devastating accident. More than 100 surgeries later, he’s thriving and focused on building a promising future.

P1.7.text: Get an inside look at Integra LifeSciences' hands-on learning environment where healthcare professionals can develop surgical skills, explore innovative techniques and build confidence through immersive, procedure-based training.

P2.2.text: Integra LifeSciences is a global medical technology leader dedicated to restoring lives. We are advancing transformational care through impactful innovation in neurosurgery and tissue reconstruction, specialized fields that demand exceptional expertise and precision. Our portfolio of highly differentiated gold-standard products and solutions is built on decades of clinical evidence and trusted by healthcare professionals to improve patient outcomes.

P2.3.text: Dr. Richard Caruso founded Integra LifeSciences and the company acquired collagen technology.

P2.4.text: Integra® Dermal Regeneration Template approved by the FDA and is engineered to promote the regeneration of dermal tissue.

P2.5.text: Leveraging its tissue regeneration technology, Integra received FDA clearance of DuraGen® Dural Graft Matrix for use as a dura substitute for the repair of the dura mater.

P2.6.text: NeuraGen® Nerve Guide is FDA cleared and provides a protective environment across nerve discontinuities.

P3.2.text: Integra offers extensive expertise in collagen biomaterials for companies seeking strategic alliances. Our collagen products are manufactured from bovine deep flexor tendon, one of the purest sources of Type 1 collagen available, with biocompatibility and safety demonstrated in over 10 million implants (neurosurgery, plastic and reconstructive surgery and orthopedic surgery). Integra is a recognized and respected industry leader with vast experience in developing innovative regenerative products with a wide array of applications, including dental applications, sports medicine, bone grafting materials, reconstructive wound healing, hemostasis and carrier technologies for drug and protein delivery.

P3.3.text: Integra is compliant with ISO 13485:2016, FDA Quality Systems Regulations and the (EU) 2017/745 Medical Device Regulations. Our wealth of experience in design control, testing requirements, manufacturing, quality systems and the regulatory approval process makes us a powerful partner to companies seeking:

P3.4.text: A private label partner: Integra manufactures products that are available for private label distribution by our customers

P3.5.text: A material supplier: Integra produces raw materials that can be integrated into our customer's production processes

P3.6.text: Customer-specific product development: Integra has the expertise to design, develop and manufacture products to meet the specific needs of our customers

P3.7.text: For complete product information, please see the Instructions for Use accompanying each product.
